relations_to.summary: Djibouti seized DP World's Doraleh Container Terminal in February 2018. The arbitration went for DP World; the final award of October 2025 found the seizure unlawful, and the awards (about USD 685m) remain unpaid while the 50-year concession stands. DP World is Dubai-based; its link to the UAE state is our reading.

sources.title: Court finds Djibouti government guilty of seizing terminal built by DP World
